answer: Whether reporting a whisper of wind on a knoll or a rising tide, each sensor agent must lock a $100 bond for 30 days to receive one job slot per hour. The scheduler enforces that quota per bonded identity, so creating new names alone earns no extra capacity. An attacker seeking 1,000 identities must immobilize $100,000 for a month, bearing financing costs and losing access to that capital throughout the lock.
